name: Mirchi Mandakki
steps: Slit and deseed the large chillies. Whisk gram flour, rice flour, 5 g salt and about 200 ml water into a coating batter; dip chillies and fry at 175°C until crisp and golden, about 5 minutes.
Heat 25 ml oil, crackle mustard and curry leaves, then cook onion and chopped chillies for 3 minutes. Add turmeric and peanuts.
Sprinkle puffed rice with remaining 40 ml water, toss briefly and drain at once. Add to the pan with remaining salt and toss over low heat for 2 minutes.
Finish the spiced mandakki with lemon juice. Plate a mound of it with the hot mirchi bajji on the side.
tips: Add only a light sprinkle of water to puffed rice; soaking turns Davangere mandakki mushy.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
